<includeonly>{{#invoke:Display|creature|{{{1|}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>
Use <nowiki>{{Creature|Sceetler}}</nowiki> or <nowiki>{{Creature|Nightmare}}</nowiki> for a compact reviewed portrait and linked creature name. This is not an infobox: health, attacks and loot remain on the creature's own page.

The argument is an existing canonical creature page title, not an entity ID or filename. MediaWiki title normalization (spaces, underscores and the first letter) is supported. Unknown names, NPCs, non-main namespaces and section fragments display an error; no image filename is guessed. A registered creature without approved portrait art keeps its name link and shows "no reviewed image".

Bestiary and the existing authored category lists use this template. MediaWiki's automatically generated category member labels remain ordinary text links; category membership and native navigation are unchanged.
</noinclude>
